top_reviews.text: Word of warning: all of the 17 pros and pro maxes I looked at at my local Apple store had very visible, large (cm+) scratches where the ceramic back panel connects to those magsafe stands apple uses. It was probably from small particles that get caught in between the stand and the phone. So get ready for scratches and marring on your phone’s back just like you get on the front of it (absent a screen protector of course) :)

Your photos dont do it justice, I would have photographed the same object with the two cameras, with the same camera settings. You photographed two entirely different objects with different settings, which makes it hard to see any difference in the flash at all, other than the 17 pro flash throws a shadow to the right side because its so far away from the actual lens, whereas the 16 pro throws the shadow almost straight

even I dont want to upgrade but few things are making me to do it, first is usb c, not because I want it, but because now its hard to find a lightning cable if you are in a place without cable as every new iphone runs on C, second is cameras, definitely the main cameras work well, but the fact that 12MP UW and telephoto degrade the quality of continuous video when switching from main camera makes me want to upgrade, third is battery health, its a day 1 pro, at 80% and upgrading the battery means I’ll have to bear these problems for another 3 years, things that are preventing me from upgrading, purple color its the best color iphone has ever had and nothing comes close to it.

I’ll be upgrading from my 14 pro max, I just don’t know if it will be the base 17 or 17 pro or an Android., People mention the 8x and usb c but for me the RAM is also an important upgrade. I’ve been having issues with a few apps getting killed in the background ( YT music especially, if I pause and don’t resume within 2-3 minutes it just reloads and ai have to open it again to play something ).

I just checked Apple’s site and it looks like they modified the trade in deal for Go5G Plus. When I checked yesterday for a 13 Pro Max trade in, it was $305 trade in credit and $495 T-Mobile bill credits. Now, it looks like it’s only a $320 trade in credit

I have the 14 pro max and I’m excited to upgrade to 17 pro max for a few reasons:, More battery, faster recharge, usb c and added usb c capabilities, Apple intelligence, Better cameras don’t hurt, Hitting the storage limit, I find I spend a lot of time charging, so having a new battery with 35% more battery ( or ~56% based on my current battery health), and 20 minutes to charge 50% means I spend less time charging or having to put my phone on low power mode, where the refresh rate tanks and performance slows- very good nice to have., USB C is becoming more and more the standard, having 1 cable for my devices is helpful to reduce clutter and stress of thinking about things I need to pack at any time. Ability to plug in a Portable SSD provides a lot of benefits in storage management. And reverse wired charging is another nice to have., I’ve only started to get into AI, Apple intelligence is currently available on my IPad and I can see the benefit of it on that device. I can see having a smarter AI on my phone really enhancing my daily user experience, and good that it can be linked to Chat GPT. This post was not written with Apple intelligence or any other AI tool but I imagine that could have saved some time if I had., Better cameras with 2.5x improved zoom, better selfie camera, better video recording capabilities-ProRes (4K 120 vs 1080p 30 - I have the 128gb) and a few other improvements., Increased storage limit, and as mentioned before ability to connect an external SSD., All of these plus a slight increase to screen size, performance boost, Vapor cooling, etc. I find to be good benefits that help me to justify my purchase, however I do note that non of these are that sexy when you consider the big changes of previous generations. So I think in the end it’s a personal choice., My current phone works well and if I wasn’t a tech enthusiast I wouldn’t be upgrading, but I discovered recently that I need to get smart with AI for my personal goals so time to upgrade.
Upgrading from a 15 Pro. I’m going with the 17 Pro Max in orange along with the orange FineWoven case and MagSafe wallet., I want a bigger screen and better battery, which was horrible on the 15 Pro.

I went into the store with a pickup order for a 1TB Cosmic Orange Pro, walked out with a 1TB Light Gold Air., I held them both side by side and every single concern I had just disappeared. I have a dedicated Canon mirrorless with telephoto and macro lenses if I need it, Im never far from a charger if I need it, I dont talk on speakerphone because I have AirPods, the big compromises just are not huge., But the size. And reverse wired charging is another nice to have., I’ve only started to get into AI, Apple intelligence is currently available on my IPad and I can see the benefit of it on that device. I can see having a smarter AI on my phone really enhancing my daily user experience, and good that it can be linked to Chat GPT. This post was not written with Apple intelligence or any other AI tool but I imagine that could have saved some time if I had., Better cameras with 2.5x improved zoom, better selfie camera, better video recording capabilities-ProRes (4K 120 vs 1080p 30 - I have the 128gb) and a few other improvements., Increased storage limit, and as mentioned before ability to connect an external SSD., All of these plus a slight increase to screen size, performance boost, Vapor cooling, etc. I find to be good benefits that help me to justify my purchase, however I do note that non of these are that sexy when you consider the big changes of previous generations. So I think in the end it’s a personal choice., My current phone works well and if I wasn’t a tech enthusiast I wouldn’t be upgrading, but I discovered recently that I need to get smart with AI for my personal goals so time to upgrade.

I went into the store with a pickup order for a 1TB Cosmic Orange Pro, walked out with a 1TB Light Gold Air., I held them both side by side and every single concern I had just disappeared. I have a dedicated Canon mirrorless with telephoto and macro lenses if I need it, Im never far from a charger if I need it, I dont talk on speakerphone because I have AirPods, the big compromises just are not huge., But the size. It felt like I was picking up a plastic dummy model, not the actual phone. Its so insanely light compared to my 16PM, it just felt like a joy to hold and look at. The gold is an amazing color, really brings back memories of the gold XS I used to have. Its a nice rich gold on the edges and camera ring, which is good.

I just did the exact opposite. It was hard to do because the air feels so good in the hand. It’s easily one of the most comfortable phones I’ve ever held., The only reasons I swapped and walked out with a promax was the battery life obviously, but also the vapor chamber. I ride a motorcycle and my phone sits on a mount on the handlebars and in the direct sun it gets pretty hot and stops charging on the wireless charger. I was worried the air was gonna have the same issue. The pro Max may still have the same issue, but anything I can do to help is worth it., The speakers on the air were noticeably quieter than the pro and pro Max, but I didn’t think it was anything that would’ve been a problem.

I stress tested mine the other day by doing some heavy Lightroom editing including AI use on RAW images. Something that my old iPhone 15PM would have literally committed suicide doing. And its only result was a slightly warm chassis and the screen dimmed by about 20%. Colour me seriously impressed.

Are you surprised? The Air is the answer to a question not very many people asked for., Its only redeeming quality is the thinness. Worse battery life. Worse camera system. Smaller screen than Pro Max. A19 Pro but it’s going to be more thermally constrained, throttled than the Pro phones. The base 17 arguably has better specs all around except for marginally smaller screen and the thickness., If anything the Air pushes more people to the either the base 17 for $200 less or the Pro Max for “only” $200 more. If they made a 17 Plus for $899 this year they would have lost a bunch of Pro Max buyers because the specs of the base 17 is so good this time.
Upgrading from a 15 Pro. I’m going with the 17 Pro Max in orange along with the orange FineWoven case and MagSafe wallet., I want a bigger screen and better battery, which was horrible on the 15 Pro.

I don’t really care one way or the other about the bump. The battery life is nice, but not worth $1, 200 for a phone with basically the same screen and a slightly better camera that takes pictures that in the real world no one will be able to tell apart from pictures taken with my iPhone 15 Pro Max. It will be basically the same experience as the phone I have now so I guess I’ll be rocking my 15 Pro Max one more year.

I have a 14pm and I’m keeping it another year for sure, Kept it since launch and I have 83% bh., I might do a battery swap next month or before year end but I intend to keep this phone for as long as I can., It does everything I need it to., Takes great pictures and videos when I need it to. - pro res is more than enough for me and for the 98%, Amazing display, Superb haptics, I can get my mail work and others done properly aaaaaaannnddddd the best part - i can make and take calls (duh)!!!, What more do you want a phone to do???

After entering my T-Mobile account information, it said my plan isn’t eligible for the special trade-in discount and that I’d need to upgrade to an Experience plan in order to receive the $800 credit.

I say upgrade. Upgrading now keeps you in line with the design refresh schedule. Apple has had a 3 year refresh schedule for the Pro line since iPhone 11 Pro:, 11 Pro, 12 Pro, 13 Pro: Glass sandwich design with rounded sides, triple cameras, and a notch, 14 Pro, 15 Pro, 16 Pro: Glass sandwich design with flat sides, triple cameras, and Dynamic Island, Its safe to assume the refresh schedule for the Pro line will be the same, 17 Pro, 18 Pro, 19 Pro: Aluminum unibody with glass MagSafe cutout, triple cameras, and Dynamic Island, If you wanted to wait for iPhone XX, it will probably release in 2027 during the iPhones 20th anniversary. It might even be iPhone 19, XX simul release like they did with the 8, X. The only reason the numbers are messed up right now is because they did the S refresh for the X. The X pretty much set the design language for the following decade so Id assume the XX will do the same
